brief: A collection of translucent, three-dimensional geometric forms that pulse and drift through a dark void, mimicking the ebb and flow of an orchestral performance. Deep blues and violets dominate during quiet passages, while sudden bursts of gold and crimson emerge during crescendos. The shapes swell, rotate, and intersect in a rhythmic, synchronized dance. Clicking the canvas cycles the visual suite, instantly transitioning the color palette and the tempo of the movement.

statement: This sketch creates an immersive, evolving collection of three-dimensional geometric forms that pulse and drift through a dark void. The visual experience is structured like an orchestral performance: quiet passages feature deep blues and violets, while sudden bursts of gold and crimson emerge during crescendos. Each shape—spheres, boxes, and tori—swells and rotates in synchronization, intersecting and moving through space with rhythmic motion. The palette cycles instantly on each click, changing both the color scheme and the tempo of movement, creating a dynamic visual suite that responds to user interaction.
